claim.summary: Disjoint pairs outside characteristic two: on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) over a field of characteristic other than 2, with m >= 2 pigeons, two distinct ones written 1 and 2, N holes, 1 <= K < D <= ceil(N/2), rho = max(2K - 1, K + 2), W = C cap V_K, C the degree-D closure, for disjoint sets of holes A, B with partition errors E_A, E_B, if A has N - |A| >= rho or |A| >= rho and max(N - |B|, |B|) >= max(2K - 1, K + 1), or the same with A and B exchanged, then Ann_C(E_A) cap Ann_C(E_B) cap V_K = W; in particular every disjoint pair has J = W when N >= 2 rho - 1. Pairs failing both orders, all at N <= 2 rho - 2, are not covered.
claim.assessment: Working proof; the argument is the reviewer's, written out in the entry and checked by the same sole fresh-context medium reviewer in a second pass, which passed it with scope corrections applied.

significance.next_action: The disjoint pairs failing both room orders in characteristic 3, first K = 3, N = 7, A = {0, 1}, B = {2, 3, 4}.

claim.summary: Partition kernels in every field: on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) over any field, with m >= 2 pigeons, two distinct ones written 1 and 2, N holes, 1 <= K < D <= ceil(N/2), rho = max(2K - 1, K + 2), W = C cap V_K, C the degree-D closure, for partition errors E_{A_i} = sum_{j in A_i} x_1j + sum_{j not in A_i} x_2j, i = 1..r, and J the intersection of the Ann_C(E_{A_i}) cap V_K: (a) for a choice of representatives R_i = E_{A_i} + Q_2 (edges in A_i) or E_{A_i} + Q_1 (edges in A_i^c) whose edge union leaves at least rho holes, J is W plus the u in V_K vanishing at every partial matching outside the intersection of the zero sets of the R_i; outside characteristic 2 these are {pigeon 2 in A, pigeon 1 not in A} and {pigeon 1 in A^c, pigeon 2 not in A^c}, in characteristic 2 the sets where exactly one of pigeons 1, 2 is matched to a hole of A, respectively of A^c; (b) for a pair the four choices leave N - |A cup B|, |A cap B|, |B minus A| and |A minus B| holes; (c) in characteristic 2, E_A + E_B = S_{A sym-diff B} with S_T = sum_{j in T}(x_1j + x_2j), so J = Ann_C(E_A) cap Ann_C(S_{A sym-diff B}) cap V_K for every pair and every K; (d) from K >= 2, for holes h != j, x_1h x_2j E_A = ([h in A] + [j not in A]) x_1h x_2j modulo H, so x_1h x_2j is a common surviving killer of E_{A_1}..E_{A_r} exactly when every A_i separates h and j in characteristic 2, and exactly when j lies in every A_i and h in none otherwise; in characteristic 2 every pair of nonempty proper sets has such a killer.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in two passes with corrections; part (d), the classification of the monomial killers, is the reviewer's suggestion, its proof written out and checked in the second pass.

claim.summary: Low-hole linear transfer: over any field, on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) with any number of pigeons and N holes, for D <= ceil(N/2) and K + 1 <= D, a set F of polynomials of degree <= 1 whose edges lie in a set L of holes and on a set P of pigeons with N - |L| >= max(2K - 1, K + 1 + min(K, |P| - 1)) has its common kernel in V_K modulo the degree-D closure C equal to its common kernel modulo the hole and functionality closure H plus C cap V_K; in particular N - |L| >= 2K + 1 suffices for every P, and max(2K - 1, K + 2) for edges on two pigeons. Proof: lem:polynomial-numbering-transfer with L's holes ranked lowest and P's pigeons last; for an edge (p, j) and a matching t with a dance, p moves at its turn to a hole above j holding no pigeon and no target of t's dance (at most K + min(K, |P| - 1) excluded), and the one pigeon of t targeting j, if it moves before p, is re-targeted (at most 2K - 1 excluded). With an arbitrary pigeon order the construction needs 2K + 1, exactly. At K = 1 it contains cor:linear-error-transfer's in-particular clause.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer; its pigeons-last room is the reviewer's suggestion, its count and exactness checked in the reviewer's follow-up.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Extends the K = 1 linear transfer to every K, so linear errors with edges in few holes, and sets of them, carry no closure killer beyond their representatives.
significance.next_action: The re-target bound 2K - 1 at K >= 4, by an augmenting-chain dance.

claim.summary: Partition common kernels: on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) with m >= 2 pigeons, two distinct ones written 1 and 2, N holes, 1 <= K < D <= ceil(N/2), rho = max(2K - 1, K + 2), W = C cap V_K, C the degree-D closure, for partition errors E_{A_i} = sum_{j in A_i} x_1j + sum_{j not in A_i} x_2j, i = 1..r, r >= 1, with union U and intersection I, and J the intersection of the Ann_C(E_{A_i}) cap V_K: (a) in characteristic other than 2, if N - |U| >= rho, J is W plus the u in V_K vanishing at every partial matching outside {pigeon 2 matched in I, pigeon 1 unmatched or matched to a hole of U^c}, so J = W when I is empty; more generally, for any choice of representatives E_{A_i} + Q_2 (edges in A_i) or E_{A_i} + Q_1 (edges in A_i^c) with N minus the size of the union of their edge sets >= rho, J is W plus the u vanishing off the intersection of their zero sets ({2 in A, 1 not in A} and {1 in A^c, 2 not in A^c}), so for two disjoint sets J = W also when |A| >= rho or |B| >= rho; (b) in characteristic other than 2, if |I| >= rho, the same with pigeons 1, 2 exchanged and the sets complemented, so J = W when U is all holes; (c) in every characteristic, if I is nonempty, U is not all holes and K >= 2, x_1h x_2j with j in I, h not in U is a common surviving killer; (d) in characteristic other than 2 and 3, for two disjoint sets with |A cup B| >= rho, J = W, through E_A + E_B = E_{A cup B} + E_{A cap B} and lem:low-hole-linear-transfer on F = 2 + sum_{j not in A cup B}(x_2j - x_1j); so outside characteristics 2 and 3 a disjoint pair has J = W at every N >= 2 rho - 1. In characteristic 2, for K >= 2, a disjoint pair of nonempty sets has the common surviving killer x_1a x_2b, a in A, b in B.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in three passes with corrections; part (d), the sum step, is the reviewer's argument, checked step by step in its second pass, and the r-error mixed choice was checked in its third.

claim.summary: Partition killer degree: on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) with at least two pigeons, two distinct ones written 1 and 2, N holes and D <= ceil(N/2), for the partition error E_A = sum_{j in A} x_1j + sum_{j not in A} x_2j with 1 <= |A| <= N - 1 and D >= 2, the least degree K <= D - 1 of a surviving killer (u in V_K outside the degree-D closure C with u E_A in C) is: (a) 1 in characteristic 2, killer sum_{j in A}(x_1j + x_2j), E_A + Q_2 being idempotent modulo the hole and functionality closure H; (b) 1 in every characteristic when A = {j} (killer x_2j) or A's complement is {h} (killer x_1h); (c) in characteristic other than 2, with 2 <= |A| <= N - 2 and N - |A| >= 3 or |A| >= 3, no linear killer survives (cor:partition-transfer-every-k at K = 1 and an evaluation on partial matchings); (d) in characteristic other than 2, with 2 <= |A| <= N - 2 and D >= 3, it is 2, killer the monomial x_1h x_2j, h not in A, j in A, which kills in every field; (e) in characteristic other than 2, from D >= 3, two partition errors E_A, E_B with A and B meeting and not covering the holes, one of them of size between 2 and N - 2, have least common surviving killer degree 2, by x_1h x_2j with j in A cap B, h outside A cup B.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections; its monomial killer and part (e) are the reviewer's, both checked in its follow-up, which also found (e)'s size condition needed for one error only.

claim.summary: Exact F_2 computation (mixing_pairs.py, mixing_domination.py, mixing_pairs_65.py, dims_65.py, mixing_pairs_54.py, mixing_pairs_76.py with tools/pc_closure.py) on the functional pigeonhole system, comparing for pairs of errors the common kernel J modulo the closure C with a (the best single pair of representatives modulo span{Q_i}: domain common kernel plus W = C cap V_K), b (the sum over representative pairs) and I (the intersection of the per-error representative sums). At 4 pigeons, 3 holes, D = 2, K = 1, on the 33 non-congruent pairs of the ten positive-excess errors of check:top-degree-partition-kernels: dim J = 5 > 4 = dim W, a = b = 4, I = 5, stacked rank 8 below the capacity 9 with summed ranks 12, and no s of degree <= 1 has Ann_C(s) cap V_1 = J (8191 tried). At 6 pigeons, 5 holes, D = 3, K = 2, partition errors with |A| in {2,3}, on the six unordered non-congruent orbits under the holes' symmetry: J = I exceeds b by 4 or 8 (300 vs 296, 290 vs 282), while a = 292 or 282 > 276 = dim W; dim V_2 = 466, ranks 134, capacity 190, stacked ranks 166 and 176. At 5 pigeons, 4 holes, D = 2, K = 1, |A| = 2, on the non-congruent orbit: dim J = 6, a = b = 5 = dim W, I = 6; dim V_1 = 21, ranks 13, capacity 16, stacked rank 15: the intersection alone gives the survivor. At 7 pigeons, 6 holes, D = 3, K = 2, |A| = 3, on the two non-congruent orbits, dim J = a = b = I = 479 > 469 = dim W (dim V_2 = 904, ranks 362, capacity 435, stacked rank 425, mixing_pairs_76.py): one pair of representatives explains every common kernel. Domination at 5, 6 and 7 pigeons is not tested.
claim.assessment: Exact computation; the four-pigeon figures reproduced by the reviewer's independent computation and every script checked by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer, which re-ran none after its second stage; domination tested at four pigeons only.
